sidebar.heading: Object storage
sidebar.deleteConnDescription: The connection and every grant under it are removed. Open browser tabs against it will fail their next request. This cannot be undone — your objects are not touched.

dialog.description: Credentials are encrypted at rest with AES-256-GCM. Use the Share button on the sidebar to grant access to another user without revealing the secret key.
dialog.backendLocalDesc: Requests dial the store from your local machine. Required for 127.0.0.1 / LAN endpoints.
dialog.backendRemoteDesc: Requests dial the store from the team backend. Use for cloud buckets.
dialog.backendNote: The connection is saved to BOTH backends — the secret is encrypted with each BE's own key. Pick which one the browser defaults to.
dialog.hintMinio: On-prem MinIO — point the endpoint at your server (e.g. http://localhost:9000).
dialog.hintCeph: Ceph RGW — set the endpoint to your object gateway URL.
dialog.hintHuawei: Huawei Cloud OBS — replace <region> in the endpoint AND set Region to the same OBS region (e.g. cn-north-4, cn-east-3, ap-southeast-1, ap-southeast-3). Signing fails if they differ.
dialog.hintCustom: Any S3-compatible endpoint. Most self-hosted stores want path-style addressing on.
dialog.errEndpointRequired: Endpoint is required for this provider

share.title: Share "{{name}}"
share.description: Requests run as YOU — recipients browse (read) or mutate (write) objects through this connection without seeing the secret key.

panel.deleteObjectDescription: This permanently deletes the object. This cannot be undone.

hints.pickConnection: Pick a connection above to get started.
hints.pickBucket: Pick a bucket to browse its objects.

empty.title: No object-storage connections
empty.body: Add a connection from the Object storage sidebar tab to get started.

detail.previewUnsupported: Binary or unsupported type — download instead.
detail.previewTooLarge: Too large to preview ({{size}}) — download instead.
